levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة

notes: «وغير، واحد» («others») is a collective gap: unnamed, in the same level as the named teachers.
Umar is the last link: his words («إن الله بعث محمدا») are reported; the Prophet is not a link.
«قال أبو عيسى هذا حديث حسن» is the compiler's grading, left out.
